context_text: Our Group TRIF was 1.7 at 30 June 2025 as we recorded an additional injury this year. While clearly disappointing, as we must hold ourselves to a high standard and believe it is possible to have a workplace that is injury free, our performance does compare favourably with other industry benchmarks.；Figure 1: FY25 TRIF vs. industry averages(a). ASX Mining Peers Avg 2.3; ICMM 5.6; Sandfire Group FY24 1.6 FY25 1.7.
